text:
Dana (Sales): Passing SunReach Bio to CS - 175-seat pilot, US + EU, requesting private VPC deploy, SAML SSO, token-level billing export, and audit logs. Pilot target go-live week of 2025-12-01. They also have a one-time bulk embedding job (~4M vectors) during pilot and want HSM for keys later. Please own onboarding and call out infra/compliance blockers.

Maya (CS): Thanks Dana. Quick q: who's their infra contact and what is expected concurrency for the bulk job vs interactive users? Also any early renewal signal?

Dana (Sales): Contact is Zoe (SunReach infra). Bulk job: ~3-5k qps over ~36h window. Interactive: ~50 concurrent users pilot, ramp to ~320 over 3 months. Renewal interest: asked about a 12-month commit and tiered discounts.

Maya (CS): Noted. Tentative owners: Maya (onboarding), Omar (support/runbook), Lin (eng infra), Kai (security/HSM), Dana (sales sponsor). I'll schedule a kickoff and open a ticket.

onboard-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-9001 "SunReach private deploy + SAML + embeddings + HSM" assigned to Omar.

Omar (Support): Runbook stub in SUP-9001: ```- Validate SAML IdP/SP metadata exchange and cert rotation windows
- Confirm VPC peering CIDR & routing, NAT/egress rules
- Define billing export schema (CSV/JSON) and sample fields
- Ingest throttling plan & shard sizing for 4M vectors (small smoke test first)
- Audit log retention & redaction policy for eval data
- HSM/KMS import vs provider-managed decision matrix``` Adding this here; please flag anything missing.

Lin (Eng): Two infra notes: 1) Model family + max seq length will change GPU footprint and KV cache sizing; confirm before provisioning. 2) If embeddings + gen run together we may need separate pools or burst config. Provision lead time for requested GPUs in EU ~8-12 business days.

Kai (Security): HSM note: if SunReach wants customer-imported keys we may need a review for attestations and key origin. Also audit log schema: avoid raw request bodies by default for PII; propose metadata + hash approach unless they request otherwise.

Maya (CS): Action list I'm capturing: 1) Kickoff + enablement (owner: Maya) 2) Open ticket + runbook (owner: Omar -> SUP-9001) 3) Confirm model family & max seq with customer (owner: Dana -> Zoe) 4) Billing export spec + sample (owner: Maya + Billing Ops) 5) Provision dedicated pool after model confirmed (owner: Lin) 6) Draft 1-page SAML checklist for Zoe's infra (owner: Maya) 7) HSM onboarding checklist (owner: Kai) 8) Renewal watch + SFDC cadence (owner: Maya).

Dana (Sales): I'll ask Zoe to confirm model family (likely 13B for gen, embeddings on a separate 2-4B embed model), max seq, and billing cadence today. Also will surface the renewal signal.

Omar (Support): I'll convert the runbook into a persistent internal doc after kickoff and add a testing checklist: small ingest smoke -> SAML login -> VPC connectivity -> audit log verification -> perf smoke (p50/p95).

Lin (Eng): I'll post model/quantization guidance to SUP-9001 and estimate provisioning ETA after Dana confirms model. If they go 70B float we need ~8xA100-80GB equiv; 13B or quantized 70B significantly reduces footprint.

Maya (CS): Scheduling kickoff: 2025-11-17 09:00 PT (Zoe + Dana + Omar + Lin + Kai). Invite sent. I'll add a "renewal-watch" tag in SFDC and set touchpoints at 180/120/60 days.

Dana (Sales): Zoe asked for a 1-page infra checklist to share with her team. Maya can you post that before EOD? I can nudge if needed.

Maya (CS): Will draft and post the 1-page infra + SAML checklist here before EOD. Closing this handoff thread 12 keep updates in SUP-9001 and the onboarding calendar.
